parameters.query: WITH c AS (SELECT client_id, client_name, tenant_id, restaurant_id, scopes FROM api_clients WHERE is_active=true AND token_hash = $1 LIMIT 1) SELECT client_id, client_name, tenant_id, restaurant_id, COALESCE(scopes, '[]'::jsonb) AS scopes, EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM api_clients WHERE is_active=true AND token_hash = $1) AS matched;
WITH ins AS (INSERT INTO idempotency_keys (conversation_key, msg_id, channel) VALUES ($1, $2, $3) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING RETURNING 1) SELECT COALESCE((SELECT 1 FROM ins), 0) AS inserted;
